name: Kunststoffe Industries Limited
about: Kunststoffe Industries Limited engages in the polymer processing and related businesses in India. The company manufactures and sells spirally wound HDPE/PP spiral pipes, PVC, CPVC, and composite pipes, tanks, chemical vessels and equipment, and anti-corrosion ducting products. Its products are used for oil & gas, water sewerage, sanitation, construction, industrial, agriculture, drainage, water supply, chemical flows, and effluent disposal applications. Kunststoffe Industries Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
